dominant_strengths: Cohesive violet-on-near-black palette with disciplined accent use for AI suggestion and active row highlighting
Clear typographic hierarchy via uppercase section labels, monospaced query fragments, and muted secondary descriptions
Thoughtful affordances: result count, keyboard hints footer, NEW/BETA badges, and inline match highlighting on 'dep'
dominant_weaknesses: The split 'Dep' prefix column visually fragments command names, making scanning the actual labels harder than a standard match-highlight
AI suggestion banner competes with the selected row for violet emphasis, diluting the single focal point of the palette
Iconography is generic (rocket, wrench, cube, file) and doesn't establish a distinctive system identity beyond Linear/Raycast conventions
fix_priorities: Replace the prefix-split layout with bold-weight match highlighting inline so command names read as whole words
Tone down the AI suggestion's violet saturation or move it to a subtler chip to preserve selection emphasis
Introduce a more proprietary icon language or typographic mark to differentiate from Raycast/Linear visual lineage
Tighten vertical rhythm between sections — COMMANDS/FILES/PEOPLE gaps feel slightly inconsistent
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral polish and behavioral utility are well-matched, but reflective distinctiveness lags because the pattern reads as a competent clone of established palettes.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it functions clearly as a command palette with grouped results, AI assist, and keyboard scaffolding, though the 'improved' framing isn't backed by a novel mechanic.
